messages:
ana: FYI canary in eu-central flapped after the chart bump. Pods failing with `invalid secret name` at startup.
ravi: paste?
ana: from init container: `failed to mount secret: secret "service-key-v2" not found`
sylvia: we renamed the value key during the chart PR to `secrets.serviceKeyV2` and added migration note. Looks like the regional secret rotation didn't create the v2 secret.
ci-bot: Release pipeline 3167894321: post-canary preflight created secret if missing, but that job runs only on global promotion, not per-region.
ravi: deploy-bot, what did you do?
deploy-bot: Canary 3167894321-eu-central paused due to CrashLoopBackOff. Action: pause promotion and open thread.
nana: options: roll back chart in eu-central, pin values to legacy secret name for eu-central only, or create missing secret manually and re-run preflight.
sylvia: manual create is fastest but we need audit trail. Pinning values in the deploy pipeline will be safer and reversible.
release-ops: change window is 25m. Prefer minimal blast radius. Recommend regional pin + annotated release, then coordinate with secrets team to reconcile.
ravi: I can queue an overrides file: `overrides/eu-central-secret-legacy.yaml` with `secrets.serviceKey: service-key-legacy` and set `helm.postUpgradeJob=true` to force preflight.
nana: annotate with `temp:regional-secret-pin` and include `temp-unpin-eta=3167896921` in metadata.
ci-bot: queued promote job 3167894335 by ravi. Preflight will run as part of the job.
deploy-bot: Queued job 3167894335. Running preflight -> creating legacy secret stub -> performing helm upgrade with overrides.
sylvia: i'll stand by to run smoke tests once pods are healthy.
ci-bot: preflight succeeded, pods are coming up.
sylvia: smoke tests green. Canary healthy after pin. :white_check_mark:
release-ops: decision recorded: apply regional value pin for eu-central, do NOT rollback chart. Follow-up: secrets team to create `service-key-v2` alias and ensure regional secret rotation completes.
ravi: adding a follow-up GH issue to the chart repo: add a gating preflight that validates secret name availability in all promoted regions before global promotion. Also add PR checklist item for secret-name renames.
nana: will update release notes: add Known Issue entry explaining the regional pin and unblock plan.
sylvia: leave release annotation `temp:regional-secret-pin` and add comment `unpin-after=3167896921`.
release-ops: agreed. Closing thread when unpin happens. Thanks all.
